\begin{tablenotes}
\small
\item \textit{Notes:} All three standard errors are computed on the same
coefficient and the same sample. The naive one treats the generated
instrument $\widehat{\mathbf S}$ as fixed data; Table~\ref{tab:coverage} puts
its coverage of a nominal 95\% interval at 0.598, and it is reported here
only so the correction is visible. The corrected analytic standard error is
Corollary~\ref{cor:var_est}; the bootstrap re-estimates every step of the
procedure in every resample, with the DT sign held at the value selected on
the estimation sample.
\item The last row is the OLS/IIV gap with the corrected standard error
of its own sampling distribution. Its null, $\boldsymbol\delta_0=\mathbf 0$,
lies outside (or on the boundary of) the enforced search domain, so it is
reported as a magnitude with a standard error rather than as a
size-correct test.
